title: Oliver Owl and the Midnight Lullaby
description: Oliver Owl is too nervous to perform his first midnight lullaby for the forest animals, but learns that singing from the heart is more important than being perfect.
character_reference: a young fluffy grey owl with large golden-orange eyes and a pale striped belly

scenes.narration: High up in the branches of the great oak tree, Oliver practiced his nightly song. He puffed out his fluffy feathers and tried to hit the highest note, but his voice cracked with a nervous squeak. The full moon was climbing higher into the sky, and soon it would be time to sing for the entire forest.
scenes.visual: Wide angle shot of a cozy nest cradled in thick oak branches, moonlight filtering through leaves, looking upward toward a glowing night sky

scenes.narration: Oliver fluttered his wings anxiously and stared down at his talons. Every other owl in his family could sing a deep, rich melody that drifted softly over the sleeping meadows. He worried his high-pitched squeak would make the sleeping rabbits giggle instead of helping them dream.
scenes.visual: Medium close up looking down into the nest, wings tucked tightly against the body, large expressive eyes filled with worry

scenes.narration: A gentle breeze rustled the silver leaves, and wise old grandfather owl glided silently onto the branch beside him. He nudged Oliver’s shoulder with a warm, soft wing. Grandfather smiled gently and whispered that every voice in the forest has its own special music.
scenes.visual: Two owls perched close together on a mossy branch, silver moonlight catching the edge of their feathers, a warm supportive posture

scenes.narration: Oliver blinked his large golden eyes and looked up at his grandfather with hope. He wanted to believe that his song could be just as comforting as anyone else's. He took a deep, steady breath of the cool night air and opened his beak once more.
scenes.visual: Close up profile view, head tilted slightly upward, beak slightly open taking in air, calm determined expression

scenes.narration: This time, instead of forcing a deep rumble, Oliver let out a soft and gentle trill that sounded just like rustling leaves. It floated out from the treetop and drifted quietly over the sleeping ferns below. Down on the forest floor, a little mouse stopped nibbling and smiled in the dark.
scenes.visual: Medium shot facing outward from the branch into empty night air, wings slightly spread as sound ripples outward into the dark

scenes.narration: More animals stirred sleepily beneath the branches, drawn to the sweet and tender melody. The baby badgers in their burrow stopped tossing and turning, settling deep into their mossy beds. Oliver realized his unique song was bringing peace to everyone in the woods.
scenes.visual: Low angle shot looking up at the singing owl silhouetted against glowing starlight, peaceful and serene atmosphere

scenes.narration: Grandfather owl hooted softly in quiet approval and nuzzled Oliver's head with pride. Oliver smiled and let his shoulders relax as he continued his gentle lullaby into the night. He learned that sharing your true self is the greatest gift you can give.
scenes.visual: Close up of an affectionate head bump between two birds, closed eyes showing deep contentment and love

scenes.narration: The forest grew wonderfully still as the last notes faded into the gentle night breeze. Oliver tucked his beak beneath his warm wing, ready for a well-deserved sleep. Follow along with our channel for more gentle bedtime stories every week.
scenes.visual: Tight close up of a sleepy owl resting head down in the soft nest, eyes gently closing as stars twinkle softly overhead
